_readme: Per-route budgets the lighthouse workflow's fixture run gates on (02 › Performance checks (Lighthouse) › Budgets, D-101, D-125). Never invented: written by `node scripts/perf/report.mjs budget <a run's lighthouse-metrics/metrics.json>` from a real fixture run, never a preview's (median + 20%, bytes rounded up to the next 1,000; a11y is the measured score). One key per route id in routes.mjs; the perf-budget table in docs/02-architecture.md matches it (web/lib/perf.test.ts). Raising a budget later needs a written reason in the PR.
